COPY (
  SELECT id, d, ts_us, ts_us::TIMESTAMP_MS AS ts_ms, ns AS ts_ns, price2, price4, amt, s, n FROM (
    SELECT i::INTEGER AS id,
      (CASE WHEN i % 11 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE DATE '2020-01-01' + (i % 800)::INTEGER END) AS d,
      (CASE WHEN i % 13 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01 00:00:00' + to_microseconds((i * 10508453117) % 63072000000000) END) AS ts_us,
      (CASE WHEN i % 17 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE make_timestamp_ns(1577836800000000000 + (i * 123456789012) % 63072000000000000) END) AS ns,
      (CASE WHEN i % 7 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((i * 37 % 20000 - 10000)::DECIMAL(18,2) * 0.01)::DECIMAL(18,2) END) AS price2,
      (CASE WHEN i % 9 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((i * 53 % 40000 - 20000)::DECIMAL(10,4) * 0.0001)::DECIMAL(10,4) END) AS price4,
      (CASE WHEN i % 5 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((i * 91 % 20000) - 10000) / 997.0 END)::DOUBLE AS amt,
      (CASE WHEN i % 6 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE 'k' || (i % 50) END) AS s,
      (i * 31 % 1000)::BIGINT AS n
    FROM range(1, 6000) t(i)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 100000 + k, (DATE '2020-03-01')::DATE, ts, ts::TIMESTAMP_NS, 1.25, 1.2500, 1.25, 'edge', 0 FROM (VALUES
      (0, TIMESTAMP '2020-02-01 00:00:00'), (1, TIMESTAMP '2020-02-01 00:00:00.000500'), (2, TIMESTAMP '2020-02-01 00:00:00.001'),
      (3, TIMESTAMP '2020-02-01 00:00:00.123456'), (4, TIMESTAMP '2020-02-01 10:00:00'), (5, TIMESTAMP '2020-03-01 00:00:00'),
      (6, TIMESTAMP '2020-03-01 00:00:01')) v(k, ts)
  )
) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 700);
